observed_stack.caveat: Observed watermark after these scenarios, not a proven worst case or a claim of unchanged aggregate peak; static frame gates and the 16-KiB guarded stack budget are unchanged.

method.stages: A baseline, B borrowed-label cache, A baseline control
method.statistics: Exclude first two searches; separate two-sample medians per mode. Reference=(A+control)/2; drift=control/A-1. No formal confidence interval.
method.timer: MCU accepted OK on Black selection -> entry into next blocking APP key wait. Profiler stopped for every performance search.
method.detached: USB cable connected, physical LCD active, no USB Screen frames during 45-second observation. Timer frozen before validation reattachment.
method.cache_reset: Only session-owned derived Pages and VMC sidecars cleared/restored; reset RAM between stages; same current game and byte-identical five APPs throughout.
method.diagnostic: Separate residents with DWT service gaps/runtime detail, plus correlated single-outstanding USB PING/PONG. Not mixed with ordinary performance samples.
method.diagnostic_layout: Final chess responsiveness series preloads both game and generic corpus before first A, byte-checks every fixture in each stage, then resets RAM/owned derived pages. Preliminary chess profiles from the generic series are excluded because first A preceded corpus installation. Generic PRIME/STRESS/INPUT/ESC already had the same complete file set in every stage.
method.keyboard_caveat: Matrix gaps are actual device-side start-to-start polling intervals. INPUT/ESC key-to-prompt uses injected virtual keys and includes 120 ms host helper per key plus FOCAL completion acknowledgement; not physical switch-edge latency.

existing_cold_latency.cold_frontends: Cold chess enters the BASIC compiler frontend; warm chess does not. Large matrix gaps are already present in A.
source_evidence: code/language_vm_resident.cpp: Flash Store callback calls idle_main_process() only
code/mk61s-M.ino: idle_main_process() does not guarantee a physical keyboard scan
code/language_vm_module_entry.cpp: execution background calls both idle_main_process() and kbd::scan()
existing_cold_latency.interpretation: A separate cold-compile responsiveness defect remains; do not interpret PONG/CRC/INPUT/ESC PASS as a claim that all keyboard latency is acceptable.
